account_confirms.archive_user: Archive {n}? They can't sign in any more. Their runtime, runs and history are kept; you can unarchive later.
account_confirms.archive_entity: Archive {n}? It stops acting and never wakes. Its memory, runs and history are kept; you can unarchive later.
account_confirms.suspend: Suspend {n}? It stops acting until you turn Active back on.
account_confirms.deactivate: Deactivate {n}? They are signed out until you turn Active back on.
account_confirms.rotate: Rotate the token of {n}? The current token stops working now; the new one is shown once.

email_switches.label: Mailboxes for users
email_switches.desc: Users may connect their own mailbox for their agents, automations and notifications. You never see anyone's mail.

email_switches.label: Agent email tools for users
email_switches.desc: Users may let their agents and workflows use their mailbox. Each user still switches the tools on for themselves.

email_switches.label: Sign-in by email
email_switches.desc: Shows 'Forgot your token?' on the sign-in page. Whoever controls a user's mailbox can then sign in as that user.
